name: Step IC, H0 = 2.4, a = 0.5
setup: Non-smooth step initial condition from the paper (eq. 32, Fig. 13): a raised middle third, H0 = 2.4, a = 0.5, fluid at rest. The network only ever saw smooth sine waves.
expect: Two waves run out from each edge of the step and form steep fronts. A high-order flux without a limiter tends to oscillate at fronts, so this is where MCL should matter.
observed: Fronts stay sharp and well placed (h error 0.67% for MCL-NN). At this time the NN without MCL is fine too, even slightly better (0.51%), with no visible overshoots; the paper's warning applies more to stronger steps (see the dam-break cases).
